notes: This is the Q185 "Appliance" (standalone, system-independent) variant, model Q2G-DP4K. Matrox also sells a "Card" variant (PCIe card, Mini DisplayPort input, no independent power/Ethernet) — not covered here since the request implies a standalone physical device. Matrox's own site (video.matrox.com) blocked automated fetching (403), so specs are sourced from a reputable AV retailer (AVLGEAR) whose spec table mirrors Matrox's published data, cross-checked against additional web sources. Power connector is a locking 4-pin DIN ("DIN4") on an external 12VDC/42W power brick — mapped to the closest available connector id, dc-barrel, since a true DIN4 option isn't in the allowed list; note this in case a more precise id is later supported. Ethernet port is 10/100/1000 Base-T (gigabit-capable), graded eth-1g. DisplayPort input is full-size (not mini) on the appliance and is DisplayPort 1.2, accepting up to 4K60 or wide inputs like 7680x1080; graded dp-1.2. HDMI outputs are not explicitly version-labeled by the retailer source (max output 1920x1080/1920x1200 @60Hz per port), so no HDMI grade was assigned — omitting grade per instructions when version is unstated. No USB or RS232/control ports are present on this device per all sources checked.
